Messages.Author: salem christ
Messages.Body:
With the Jackal retainer, if i am doing a D action against my
predator, and he is playing, say, malkavians, my minion with a Jackal
gets +1 stealth on that action if my prey has a ready follower of set
or an assamite.

Now that's, well, novel. Should this retainer have some sort of errata
along the lines of the [+bleed when prey controls clan X] to [+ bleed
when bleeding meth who controls clan X] errata? But then i guess we'd
be taking a sucky card and making it suck more, to use technical CCG
terminology.

*sigh* i wouldn't have to be thinking this if the sydney pre-release
had happened. i'd be too busy making decks with all the spiffy new
cards.

salem.
